title: The Application of Artificial Intelligence in Predicting Embryo Transfer Outcome of Recurrent Implantation Failure.
summary: A machine-learning system predicts embryo-transfer outcome and transfer-number decisions in recurrent implantation failure using a retrospective dataset; held-out/cross-validation metrics support a narrowly scoped clinical outcome prediction result. External replication and prospective utility were not established.
ai_technology: AI models use clinical/embryology variables to predict embryo-transfer outcome.
